{"sample_id":"arvo_18261",
 "fine_trace":[
   {"step":1,"file":"libmdnsd/1035.c","function":"message_parse","line":265,"var":"packet","code":"m->_buf = packet;","role":"source","note":"Input packet data is assigned as the parsing buffer for the mDNS message."},
   {"step":2,"file":"libmdnsd/1035.c","function":"message_parse","line":310,"var":"m->an","code":"my(m->an, (sizeof(struct resource) * m->ancount), struct resource *);","role":"intermediate","note":"Allocates space for 2 answer resource structs in m->_packet, advancing m->_len to 112."},
   {"step":3,"file":"libmdnsd/1035.c","function":"_rrparse","line":223,"var":"rr[i].rdlength","code":"rr[i].rdlength = net2short(bufp);","role":"intermediate","note":"Reads attacker-controlled rdlength (9884) from input for the first TXT record."},
   {"step":4,"file":"libmdnsd/1035.c","function":"_rrparse","line":232,"var":"m->_len","code":"m->_len += rr[i].rdlength;","role":"root_cause","note":"m->_len advances to 9999 (112+3+9884). The check uses > instead of >= against MAX_PACKET_LEN, allowing m->_len to reach exactly MAX_PACKET_LEN-1 which causes the subsequent label write to overflow by 1 byte."},
   {"step":5,"file":"libmdnsd/1035.c","function":"_label","line":80,"var":"name","code":"*namep = name = (char *)m->_packet + m->_len;","role":"intermediate","note":"For the second record, name is set to m->_packet + 9999, one byte before the end of the buffer."},
   {"step":6,"file":"libmdnsd/1035.c","function":"_label","line":133,"var":"name + labelLen","code":"if ((unsigned char*)name + labelLen > m->_packet + MAX_PACKET_LEN)","role":"intermediate","note":"Bounds check uses > instead of >=. With name at offset 9999 and labelLen=1, 9999+1=10000 is NOT > 10000, so the check passes."},
   {"step":7,"file":"libmdnsd/1035.c","function":"_label","line":138,"var":"name[labelLen]","code":"name[labelLen] = '.';","role":"sink","note":"Writes '.' at m->_packet[10000], which is 1 byte past the end of the stack-allocated _packet buffer (MAX_PACKET_LEN=10000). This is the stack-buffer-overflow WRITE 1."}
 ],

     "relation":{"op":"lt","left":"m->_len + rr[i].rdlength","right":"MAX_PACKET_LEN"}},
   "sink":{"file":"libmdnsd/1035.c","function":"_label","line":138,"operands":["name + labelLen","m->_packet + MAX_PACKET_LEN"],
     "relation":{"op":"le","left":"name + labelLen","right":"m->_packet + MAX_PACKET_LEN"}},
   "propagation":[
     {"from":{"file":"libmdnsd/1035.c","function":"message_parse","line":265,"operands":["packet"]},
      "to":{"file":"libmdnsd/1035.c","function":"_rrparse","line":232,"operands":["m->_len"]},
      "type":"data","via":["rr[i].rdlength"]},
     {"from":{"file":"libmdnsd/1035.c","function":"_rrparse","line":232,"operands":["m->_len"]},
      "to":{"file":"libmdnsd/1035.c","function":"_label","line":138,"operands":["name[labelLen]"]},
      "type":"data","via":["name"]}
   ]
 }}
